t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The taller gnomes are usually better than the shorter gnomes, and some colors are better than others, but it varies.

vb_textbox.text: Unfortunately, I couldn't detect a pattern in the choices. So the only real advice I have is to make sure to make your choices quickly so you don't miss baskets.I do think there may possibly be a pattern to when each forest yields. In each choice, one gnome leads you to red basket and the other to yellow basket.
